contentPattern.structure: icon + heading + bulleted list of links + optional CTA button

suitableFor: contact/help tile grids where each tile has an icon, heading, and list of links
how-can-we-help sections routing users to forms
icon-led navigation tiles with an optional CTA button
notSuitableFor: photo/product card grids with large cover images (use cards-product)
image tile + single label link grids (use cards-industry)
